extensionDescription.message: Kontrol pemutaran, volume, kecepatan, kotak samping, dan informasi video Instagram dengan lebih mudah.

tooltipMute.message: Bisukan atau aktifkan suara semua video

debugRemoteHint.message: Saat aktif, eksekusi otomatis berhenti dan tombol langkah muncul di sisi kanan halaman.

donatePromptMessage.message: Apakah Anda menikmati aplikasi ini? Jika ya, pertimbangkan untuk mendukung pengembang.

nativeControlsHint.message: Show Instagram video controls on the video itself.

backwardIntervalHint.message: Step size for the back button.

forwardIntervalHint.message: Step size for the forward button.

volumeControlHint.message: Apply the extension volume value to detected videos.

muteControlHint.message: Apply mute and unmute state from the extension.

playbackRateControlHint.message: Apply the extension playback speed to videos.

keyboardShortcutsHint.message: Enable M, comma, period, and B shortcuts.

squareVideoContainerHint.message: Remove rounded corners from the video container.

standalonePostLayoutHint.message: Widen standalone post layout for the side box.

hideInstagramVideoPlayerHint.message: Hide Instagram's own Video player overlay elements.

autoScanHint.message: Keep scanning the page as Instagram changes videos.

sideBoxEnabledHint.message: Turns off every side-box feature below when disabled.

sideBoxInfoHint.message: Add the upper area that receives Instagram post data.

moveInfoToSideBoxLabel.message: Move post info into side box

moveInfoToSideBoxHint.message: Move captions and related info from Instagram overlays.

hideMovedInfoOverlayHint.message: Hide original overlays after moving info into the box.

sideBoxControlsHint.message: Add play, mute, seek, speed, volume, and donate controls.

sideBoxRestoreButtonHint.message: Show a button to bring back the side box after hiding it.

sideBoxDonatePromptHint.message: Allow the side box to show the occasional support prompt.

hideReelClickCoverHint.message: Hide the transparent click layer covering Reels videos.

sideBoxColorHint.message: Background color for the controller box.

debugLogVisibleHint.message: Show page logs in the top-right corner of Instagram.

debugLogThemeHint.message: Pick contrast for the page overlay.

targetPostPageHint.message: Run the side box on regular post pages.

targetSingleReelPageHint.message: Run the side box on individual Reel pages.

targetReelsFeedPageHint.message: Run the side box on the Reels feed page.

targetStoriesPageHint.message: Run the side box on Stories pages.
